-- OH-9: Derek Merrin won R primary, faces Marcy Kaptur (D incumbent)
UPDATE house_races 
SET candidate2_name = 'Derek Merrin', candidate2_party = 'R',
    notes = CONCAT(COALESCE(notes, ''), ' Derek Merrin (R) won OH-9 Republican primary. Faces incumbent Marcy Kaptur (D). Source: AP, May 2026.')
WHERE state_code = 'OH' AND district = 9;

-- NE-2: Denise Powell won D primary
UPDATE house_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'Denise Powell', candidate1_party = 'D',
    notes = CONCAT(COALESCE(notes, ''), ' Denise Powell (D) won NE-2 Democratic primary. Source: AP, May 2026.')
WHERE state_code = 'NE' AND district = 2;
